title: Signature Harness Design
description: Builds criterion-style harnesses with warmup, batching, and outlier rejection. Warmup settles caches and JITs; batching amortizes timer overhead; outlier rejection drops the noise. A good harness measures the code, not the measurement. This is a Signature original authored by Justin Addam Higgins — an original technique in the Signature system, clearly labeled Signature and not presented as public record.
key_mechanisms: Warm up caches and JITs before timing

title: Signature Statistical Rigor
description: Reports confidence intervals and effect sizes instead of single best times. A result without uncertainty is a guess; the rigorous suite quantifies noise and only claims what the data supports. It ends arguments about whose laptop is faster. This is a Signature original authored by Justin Addam Higgins — an original technique in the Signature system, clearly labeled Signature and not presented as public record.
key_mechanisms: Collect enough runs for stable stats

title: Signature Regression Detection
description: Flags performance regressions over 3 percent against rolling baselines in CI. Baselines track recent history per hardware class, so the detector compares against reality, not a stale number. Regressions block the merge until explained. title: Signature Performance Baselines

title: Signature Micro vs Macro Balance
description: Pairs nanosecond microbenchmarks with end-to-end workload tests. Microbenchmarks find hot spots; macrobenchmarks prove user-visible wins. Suites that only do one or the other optimize the wrong thing.
